Zara (CS): hey y'all, Zara here — taking over a small AE book from Owen this week. need HubSpot support seat, Dialpad softphone + direct line (EU), and the "lite" CS playbook. who should i tag for fast provisioning? cc @Owen
Owen (AE): welcome Zara! :wave: i'll DM the account list and note which demos to watch. ping Marta for seats. quick checklist: hubspot support role, dialpad softphone+number, gong listen access, and add you to onboarding@redwood.ai.
Zara (CS): awesome — do CS folks get macros in HubSpot or is that sales-only? would save time for standard intros.
Marta (IT): hi Zara 30 we grant the 'Support User' role which includes templates/macros on a per-team basis. request via ticket or slash command. example:
```
/seat-request product=hubspot role=support_user user=zara@redwood.ai notes="needs macros + templates" region=eu
```
Dialpad command:
```
/seat-request product=dialpad seat=softphone user=zara@redwood.ai request_number=true region=eu phone_features=sms,voicemail
```
If you want Gong include `product=gong role=listen folders="EMEA Demos"`. Add `expedite=true` if urgent.
Zara (CS): perfect. also saw a note about a "lite" CS playbook 30 where's that? i don't need the full runbook right away.
Kai (Ops): the condensed playbook (2 pages) is at https://drive.redwood.ai/CS/lite_playbook.pdf 30 has the 24h intro, week0 checklist, and quick escalation contacts. for collateral there's a small folder with a 1-slide deploy overview you can attach to the intro email.
Owen (AE): i'll attach the 2 demo clips and the recommended Gong sequence IDs in the DM. fyi, tag account_tier in the ticket so CS knows SLA expectations.
Zara (CS): handy. one more Q 30 when do new CS agents get added to the shared inbox onboarding@redwood.ai?
Ellen (CS Director): onboarding@redwood.ai is managed by CS Ops. once your HubSpot seat+SSO is provisioned Kai will add you to the inbox and to the rotation. i'll assign two shadow accounts for you to start with after provisioning.
Zara (CS): great. quick timing q: i'm free 14:00-15:30 CEST tomorrow for a 20m handoff sync 30 does that work for Owen?
Owen (AE): 14:15 CEST works for me, sending invite now. i'll walk through the top 5 accounts and the two demos.
Marta (IT): created Ticket #5100 for Zara: HubSpot (support_user + templates), Dialpad (softphone + EU number + SMS), Gong Listen (folders: EMEA Demos). ETA: 1 business day. include `mfa-reset=true` in the ticket if SSO fails.
welcome-bot: Welcome Zara! Onboarding checklist assigned. Please finish security training and sign the data handling attestation.
Zara (CS): thanks all 30 i'll wait for ticket updates and slot the email template into Gong once i get access. can someone paste the short intro email here if it's quick?
Owen (AE): pasting short intro (copy/paste friendly):
"Hi {{first_name}},

I'm Zara from Redwood Customer Success 30 I'll be your main contact during onboarding. Could we schedule a 30-minute setup call this week? Please reply with a few times that work for you or click here to book: <booking_link>.

Thanks,
Zara"

Zara (CS): perfect, i'll add that to the CS-Onboard sequence. thanks everyone :seedling:
